purpose: Precommit the domain-neutral classification rules applied to the already-frozen held-out panel. The rubric must not be changed after selected source bodies are inspected merely to improve support rates.

HIDDEN-001.name: NON_TRANSITIVE_EVIDENCE_BINDING_LADDER
HIDDEN-001.support_definition: SUPPORT only when the held-out record itself distinguishes at least two adjacent evidence/binding layers and explicitly prevents lower-layer evidence from automatically establishing a stronger upper-layer claim, OR contains a lower-layer PASS/ESTABLISHED state while a logically stronger upper-layer state remains OPEN/BLOCKED/NOT_ESTABLISHED under the same record.
HIDDEN-001.strong_support: At least three ordered evidence layers are explicitly represented and one or more no-auto-promotion boundaries are encoded between them.
HIDDEN-001.weak_support: Exactly two distinguishable evidence layers with an explicit no-auto-promotion rule.
HIDDEN-001.contradiction_definition: CONTRADICTION only when the record explicitly treats evidence at a weaker layer as sufficient by itself to establish a stronger layer that the rubric treats as distinct, without an additional discriminator or gate.
HIDDEN-001.not_applicable: No ordered or strength-distinct evidence/binding layers can be established from the source body without semantic invention.
HIDDEN-001.forbidden_inference: Do not infer a ladder solely from several keys named stage, gate, level, state or status. The source must encode an evidential-strength or binding distinction.

HIDDEN-002.name: AMBIGUITY_IS_A_FIRST_CLASS_STATE
HIDDEN-002.support_definition: SUPPORT only when the held-out record explicitly preserves OPEN/UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED/UNDETERMINED/null/a candidate set/multiple alternatives because available evidence does not select a unique answer, or explicitly forbids guessing/forcing a singleton until an additional discriminator is supplied.
HIDDEN-002.strong_support: The record both preserves ambiguity and names the future evidence/gate capable of resolving it.
HIDDEN-002.weak_support: The record preserves ambiguity or null rather than forcing a value, but does not specify a resolving discriminator.
HIDDEN-002.contradiction_definition: CONTRADICTION only when the record explicitly mandates selecting a unique candidate despite declaring that the available evidence does not discriminate among multiple live candidates.
HIDDEN-002.not_applicable: OPEN/PENDING states are merely workflow incompleteness, missing execution, or future scheduling and are not epistemic ambiguity among live alternatives.
HIDDEN-002.forbidden_inference: Do not count every OPEN, PENDING or null field as ambiguity. The reason must be insufficient discriminating evidence or unresolved competing bindings/hypotheses.

HIDDEN-003.name: FIRST_BREAK_LOCALIZATION_GENERALIZES_BEYOND_VISUAL_SCORING
HIDDEN-003.applicability_definition: APPLICABLE only when the record contains an ordered chain of at least three evidence/gate boundaries whose downstream admissibility depends on preceding boundaries.
HIDDEN-003.support_definition: SUPPORT only when the record itself localizes or preserves the earliest blocking/failed/unresolved boundary, or explicitly prevents a later/aggregate success from masking an earlier failed prerequisite.
HIDDEN-003.formal_applicability_only: Use when an ordered >=3 boundary chain exists but the source does not itself encode first-failure localization semantics.
HIDDEN-003.contradiction_definition: CONTRADICTION only when the record explicitly defines downstream or aggregate success as sufficient to override an earlier failed prerequisite in the same ordered chain.
HIDDEN-003.not_applicable: Lists of independent checks, unordered requirement sets, or chronology without prerequisite semantics do not qualify as boundary chains.
HIDDEN-003.forbidden_inference: Do not transform an arbitrary list into a causal or prerequisite ordering simply because JSON preserves list order.

panel_level_promotion_rule.heldout_transport_candidate: May be asserted for a hidden pattern only if at least 3 held-out source families receive SUPPORT under the frozen rubric, at least 2 distinct top-level repository domains/families are represented, no more than half of supporting records belong to one normalized family, and all contradictions/not-applicable records are retained.
panel_level_promotion_rule.heldout_transport_strong: Requires at least 5 supporting held-out families, at least 3 distinct source-family/domain buckets, zero explicit contradictions, and a subsequent adjacency/assignment rewire test showing loss of the target relation under matched destructive controls.
panel_level_promotion_rule.failure_rule: If support threshold is not reached, record FAIL_OR_INSUFFICIENT_HELDOUT_TRANSPORT; do not replace panel members or weaken the rubric.
panel_level_promotion_rule.external_replication: Never granted by this internal held-out panel because all records remain inside the same repository/common authorship environment.
